name: 4 mm banana socket
summary: Panel binding post. Needs a 6 mm round hole.
source: Dimensions follow the commonly sold part. These are made by many suppliers to no common standard, so measure yours before cutting a panel. The threaded barrel on the common panel socket is 6 mm, held by a nut behind. Insulated shrouds vary from 10 to 14 mm across the front.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and cable
